fomod.Name: Zenderal - Faster Sprint
fomod.Author: Zenderal
fomod.Description:
Increases sprint speed (player and NPCs) by 80% over EGO - Enderal Gameplay Overhaul's current sprint values (440/450 -> 792/810 ForwardWalk/ForwardRun on the two sprint MovementType records). Global, not player-only - NPCs sprint faster too, preserving relative combat pacing against EGO's slower baseline.
Requires "EGO SE - Enderal Gameplay Overhaul" to be active and load BEFORE this plugin (this plugin overrides its sprint values, so it must win the conflict).
